title: DO NOT LEAVE YOUR HOUSE WITHOUT THIS PRAYER
text: Somebody is about to make a terrible mistake, not a financial mistake, not a career mistake, a spiritual one. They are about to step out of their house into the most dangerous day of their life without the covering of God, without the blood activated, without the angels assigned, without the name declared. And God in his sovereign mercy has arranged this moment. This is not content, this is not a program, this is an intervention. Before I go further, I need you to stop. I need you to look at your phone right now. There is someone in your contact list, a name came to your mind already. That [clears throat] person is walking into something today without a single prayer said. They do not know what is waiting. The assignment against them is real. The ambush has been set, and you God chose you to be the instrument of their rescue. Share this before you receive it, not as promotion, as prophecy. You might not understand it fully, share it anyway. Obedience is not waiting until you understand. Obedience is moving at the prompting. Now Father, Kala, Shonda, Ah Yeshua, El Shaddai, Mishpa, Ruach, Echad, Shalom Ah, El Elyon, Kadosh. Holy Ghost, breathe on this altar right now. Let the atmosphere shift, let every distraction fall. Let every spirit that is not of God vacate this space because we are about to stand on holy ground. In the name of Jesus, amen. Hear me, every single day that you are alive, there is a war happening around you that your physical eyes cannot see. This is not poetry, this is not metaphor, this is the revealed reality of scripture. Open to 2 Kings chapter 6 verses 16 and 17. The prophet Elisha and his servant stood in the city of Dothan. The servant woke up in the morning, he looked out and saw the Syrian army, horses, chariots, soldiers surrounding the city. He panicked. He said, "Master, what shall we do?" And Elisha said, "Fear not, for they that be with us are more than they that be with them." Then Elisha prayed. He did not just declare, he prayed first. "Lord, I pray thee, open his eyes that he may see." And the Lord opened the eyes of the young man, and he saw, and behold the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha. Listen carefully. The protection was already there. The angels were already stationed. The fire was already encamped, but the servant could not see it because his eyes were closed. The problem was not the absence of protection. The problem was the absence of spiritual sight. And one of the primary tools for opening spiritual sight, one of the primary vehicles for activating heavenly provision, is prayer. When you pray before you leave your house, you are not informing God of where you are going. He already knows. You are not reminding God to protect you. He does not forget. What you are doing is something far more powerful. You are aligning yourself with a covenant. You are positioning yourself under a covering. You are activating an agreement. You are releasing the angels to go ahead of you. You are marking the day with the blood before the enemy can mark it with a curse. Now, go to Psalm 91. This is the mountain of divine protection. This is not a nice Psalm to read at funerals. This is a warfare declaration. This is a covenant document. This is a legal instrument in the spirit realm. Verse one says, "He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty." Dwelleth, [music] not visits, not passes through, not occasionally enters, dwells. There is a secret place. It is not a physical location. [music] It is a spiritual position. It is the place of intimacy with the Most High. It is accessed through prayer. It is accessed through worship. It is accessed through the word. And when you dwell there, when you make your habitation in that secret place, you abide under the shadow of the Almighty. The shadow means proximity. To be in someone's shadow, you must be very close to them. God is saying, "I want you so close to me that my shadow covers you. That when the enemy looks for you, all he sees is me." This is divine protection, not insurance, not luck, not coincidence. The deliberate shadow of an Almighty God. Verse 11 declares it plainly, "For he shall [music] give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways, in all thy ways." Not some of your ways, not the Sunday ways, not the church ways, all thy ways. The Monday morning commute, the marketplace, the office, the school run, the hospital visit, the journey nobody warned you about, all thy ways. There are dimensions to this that the average believer has never accessed. I decree and declare right now over every life under the sound of this voice, you are entering into the secret place. The shadow of the Almighty is your covering today. Angels have been assigned to your day. Right now, in this moment, every ambush set against your path, dismantled. Every accident engineered for today, canceled. Every evil report prepared with your name on it, destroyed by the blood of Jesus, by the fire of the Holy Ghost. I need you to stay with me. In the book of Job chapter 1, there is a scene in heaven that should arrest every believer. The sons of God presented themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them. The Lord asked Satan, "Where have you been?" And Satan answered, "From going to and fro in the earth and from walking up and down in it." Hear me. The enemy does not park. He does not rest. He is moving. He is scouting. He is looking for openings. He is seeking, as 1 Peter chapter 5 verse 8 declares, "whom he may devour." He's not looking for evil people. He's looking for uncovered people. He's looking for prayerless people. He's looking for believers who stepped out of the house without the blood applied, without the word declared, without the name of Jesus on their lips. This is why the instruction of the spirit tonight is urgent. This is not optional devotion for the super spiritual. This is survival equipment. Thus saith the spirit of God, "The enemy has been exploiting the prayerlessness of my people. He has been walking through [music] doors that prayer would have shut. He has been occupying spaces that worship would have filled. He has been poisoning wells that [music] declaration would have purified." The Lord says this is the hour to close the gaps. This is the hour to seal the doors. This is the hour to rise and pray with the authority you have been given. Ephesians chapter 1 verses 19 through 21 tells us what kind of authority we carry. The exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, the same power that raised Jesus from the dead, the same power that set him far above all principality and power and might and dominion, and every name that is named, that power is resident in you, not in your pastor, in you, not in the anointed man on the platform, in you. In every believer who has received the Holy Ghost, that resurrection power leaves. But power must be activated, power must be deployed. Power sitting idle in a vessel that never prays is like having a loaded weapon and going into battle with your hands behind your back. Hear me, this is not theology, this is encounter. Luke chapter 10, verse 19, "Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you. Nothing." That is a sweeping, total, comprehensive declaration. Nothing, not accidents, not evil arrows, not witchcraft, not disease, not ambush. Nothing by any means shall hurt you. But this protection has a condition. It operates within a covenant framework, and that covenant is accessed through faith, expressed through prayer. Someone under the sound of my voice, you have been in a season where nothing seem to be working. You have been walking through days feeling exposed, feeling vulnerable, feeling like something is hunting you and you cannot name it. The Lord says what you are sensing is real. The assignment is real, but hear this, the assignment is authorized to operate only in an uncovered space, and tonight the covering comes. Tonight you step back under the shadow. Tonight the agreement of protection is reactivated over your life, in the name of Jesus. Father, we enter this prayer from a position of authority, not begging, not pleading with an unwilling God. Enforcing what Jesus already won. Activating what the covenant already guarantees. Standing on promises that cannot fail. Father, in the name of Jesus, I activate divine protection over every life under this voice right now. Let the blood of Jesus form a boundary, not a thin line, a wall of fire. As Zechariah chapter 2 verse 5 declares, "For I said the Lord will be unto her a wall of fire round about and will be the glory in the midst of her." Lord, be a wall of fire around every person on this altar. Around their children, around their homes, around their vehicles, around their places of work, around their journeys today, around every space they occupy, let the fire go before them. Let the fire come behind them. Let the fire surround them on every side. North, south, east, west, every direction covered. Above, below, within, without. Covered, sealed, protected by the blood, [singing] by the fire in the name of Jesus. Now I speak to every evil assignment, every arrow of darkness that was not and aimed at your life this day, I command it to fall. Psalm 91:5 says, "Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flyeth by day." Every arrow, in the name of Jesus, fall. Every arrow of sudden death, fall. Every arrow of strange disease, fall. Every arrow of financial destruction, fall. Every arrow of marital crisis, fall. Every arrow of accident and calamity, fall. Every arrow of bad news, fall. Fall. Fall. Fall. In the mighty name of Jesus. I speak to demonic surveillance. There are evil eyes that have been watching your movements. There are familiar spirits that have been mapping your patterns. There are principalities that have been studying your schedule, looking for a vulnerable moment. Looking for an uncovered season. Looking for a crack in the spiritual armor. Father, in the name of Jesus, I blind every evil eye that is watching. I confuse every demonic intelligence that has gathered information about this life. I scatter every plan assembled in the dark counsel of the wicked. Second Thessalonians chapter 3 verse 3 declares, "But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you and keep you from evil." He is faithful. Not sometimes faithful, always faithful. Not faithful when you deserve it, faithful by nature. His faithfulness is not a response to your performance. It is an expression of his character. I receive his faithfulness now. Over my life, over my household, over my destiny. The spirit of God is saying something right now. There is a man I see him, his name is Chukwuemeka or a name that carries that weight. He has had recurring nightmares. The same dream more than three times. A dream that leaves him unsettled in the morning. The Lord says that dream is a communication from the enemy about an assignment. But hear this, the assignment has no legal ground. It is operating on borrowed time. And tonight the legal ground is being destroyed. The dream stops. The assignment ends. The peace comes by the blood of the lamb. In Jesus' name. Father, I pray for the travelers, every person who will be on the road today, every person who will board a vehicle, a bus, a train, a plane, every person who will make a journey short or long. Lord, go before them. Smooth the way. Remove every obstruction. Reroute every collision. Redirect every accident. Make the enemies ambushes fail before they are deployed. I decree not one person covered by this blood reaches their destination broken. They arrive whole. They arrive on time. They arrive in peace. The angel of the Lord encamped round about them that fear him and delivered them. That is Psalm 34:7 and it is their portion today. I speak against every satanic installation on major roads. Every witchcraft emblem placed at crossroads. Every territorial demon assigned to bring accidents and casualties. I bind you in the name of Jesus. I dismantle your assignments. I break your power over the journey of God's people. Now, let us deal with the workplace. Father, every person going to work today, cover them. Cover them from office politics engineered by darkness. Cover them from colleagues who are operating as instruments of the enemy. [music] Cover them from unjust accusations. Cover them from the spirit of error that causes costly mistakes. Cover them from back door conspiracies designed to destroy their career. Let the favor of God go into the office before they arrive. Let angels clear the atmosphere. Let wisdom follow them into every meeting room. Let the favor of God make their presence desirable. Let the words they speak carry weight and produce results. Proverbs chapter 21:31. The horse is prepared against the day of battle, but safety is of the Lord. You can prepare. You should prepare, but safety ultimately is of the Lord. And I am calling on that safety right now over every life, over every plan, over every day. I speak to the family now. Father, the homes of your people are holy. Let every home touched by this prayer become a sanctuary. Let the blood of Jesus mark every doorpost and lintel. Like in Exodus chapter 12, when the destroyer passed through Egypt, he could not enter the houses marked with blood. Lord, let that covenant be real tonight. Mark our homes. Mark our children. Mark our spouses. Let the destroyer see the blood and pass over. I speak [music] to every child going to school today. They are covered. They are protected. No weapon formed against them in that school shall prosper. No peer pressure. No perversion. No evil influence shall find root in their hearts. The angels of God are their escorts. The spirit of God is their teacher. They go in covered and they return home covered. In Jesus name. There is a mother watching this right now. Her name is Adaezi or something close. She has been carrying deep anxiety about one of her children. A child who seems to be drifting. A child who has been making choices that break her heart. She has been praying. She has been fasting. She has not stopped. The Lord says to her tonight, your prayers have not been wasted. I have that child in my sight. The prodigal is coming home. The turning begins this week. What looks like drift, I am about to turn into direction. Trust me with this child. I am not finished. Receive it in Jesus name. Now, I speak against every evil covenant and ancient curse. [music] Father, we stand on the finished work of the cross. Galatians chapter 3 verse 13 declares, Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law being made a curse for us. For it is written, cursed is everyone that hangeth on a tree. every curse has been legally destroyed. But legally destroyed does not mean automatically neutralized in the individual life. It must be appropriated. It must be declared. It must be enforced. So tonight, I enforce it. Every generational curse operating in this bloodline, broken. The curse of untimely death, broken. The curse of poverty and perpetual lack, broken. The curse of barrenness and unfruitfulness, broken. The curse of marital failure and broken homes, broken. The curse of sickness that moves through generations, broken. The curse of mental illness and emotional torment, broken. Every ancient covenant with darkness, annulled. Every agreement made over this bloodline without your consent, cancelled. By the blood of Jesus, by the authority of the name above all names, it is done. It is finished. It is over. Now I speak to the altars. There are physical altars and there are spiritual altars. A spiritual altar is a place of power erected in the spirit realm. It is maintained through sacrifice, through incantation, through occult ritual. And once erected, it begins to speak against whoever it was built against. But hear me, an altar against you must be dismantled at a higher altar. And we have access to the highest altar in existence, the altar of the blood of Jesus, the altar of Calvary, the altar that speaks as Hebrews chapter 12 verse 24 declares, "Better things than the blood of Abel." >> [music] >> From that altar, I speak tonight. Every altar erected against your journey, catch fire. Every altar speaking sickness over your body, catch fire. Every altar calling for accident in your life catch fire. >> Lord. Every altar commanding stagnation and retrogression catch fire. Every altar hindering your advancement catch fire. Let the fire of God consume it. Let nothing remain in the name of Jesus. Fire. Father, let your glory settle here. Let the atmosphere shift over every home connected to this prayer right now. Now, I address the angels in accordance with Psalm 103:20. Bless the Lord ye his angels that excel in strength that do his commandments hearkening onto the voice of his word. Angels hearken to the voice of the word. When the word is declared, they move. When the word is prayed, they are activated. Angels of protection go ahead of these lives today. Clear every road, secure every path, neutralize every threat before it materializes, turn back every assignment before it arrives. Angels of divine connection be activated. Go before these lives into every room, every meeting, every conversation. Prepare the hearts of the people they will encounter today. Set up divine appointments that will alter the trajectory of their destiny. Angels of healing be released over every sick body. Every organ that is malfunctioning, the healing angel touches it right now. Every chronic condition the healing angel is addressing it at the root. I decree by his stripes you are healed. That is Isaiah chapter 53:5 and [music] it is active over your body tonight. Someone under this voice is fighting a diagnosis they received recently. A report that shook them. A medical word that landed like a death sentence. The Lord says I have the final report and my report says healed. My report says whole. My report says this is not on to death. This is for the glory of God as John chapter 11 verse 4 declares over the situation of Lazarus and I speak it over your situation tonight. You will not die from this. You will testify from this in Jesus mighty name. Father preservation over the night seasons. Psalm 121 verses 3 through 8. He that keepeth thee will not slumber. Behold he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep. God watches in the night. When you sleep, he does not. When your eyes close, his do not. When your guard is down, his is not. I decree peaceful nights over every life. No terror by night. No arrow by day. No evil dreams. No satanic visitations during sleep. The sleep of the righteous is sweet as Proverbs chapter 3 verse 24 declares. Receive sweet sleep. Receive guarded nights. Receive preserved mornings. Now let us deal with the mind. Father, the mind is a battlefield. The enemy knows that if he can capture the mind, he has captured everything because as a man thinketh in his heart, so is he. That is Proverbs chapter 23 verse 7. [music] The enemy assigns spirits of fear, anxiety, depression, confusion, and suicidal ideation to the mind of believers. He plants thoughts and waits for them to take root. He whispers in the night season. He speaks in moments of vulnerability. He uses circumstances as a megaphone for his lies. But 2 Corinthians chapter 10 verses 4 and 5 gives us our weapon. The weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds, casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalted itself against the knowledge of God. And bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ. I decree every stronghold in the mind comes down right now. Every imagination of fear, failure, and defeat pulled down. Every thought that has been tormenting, harassing, and oppressing, I take it captive, I bind it, I cast it out in the name of Jesus. I release the mind of Christ over every believer tonight. 1 Corinthians chapter 2 verse 16, we have the mind of Christ. Let that mind be active in you. Let that mind govern your thoughts. Let that mind be your default setting from this moment. Someone watching this right now has been fighting thoughts of giving up, not just about a situation, about life itself. The pressure has been so heavy that you have wondered whether it is worth continuing. The Lord sees you in that private space. He hears the thoughts you have not said aloud, and he says, "I am here. I have not left you in this. What you are feeling is real, but it is not the full picture. There is a morning coming after this night, and in that morning you will understand why I kept you. Hold on. Do not let go. Your story is not over. I decree protection over that mind. I break every spirit of suicide and self-destruction. I cut every cord of hopelessness and despair. I release the spirit of hope. Romans chapter 15 verse 13, "Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing that you may abound in hope through the power of the Holy Ghost. Abound in hope, not merely survive in hope, abound. I receive it in Jesus name. Now, protection over finances and resources. Father, the enemy has been assigned to rob, steal, and destroy. John chapter 10 verse 10 tells us his mandate. The thief cometh not but for to steal and to kill and to destroy. But Jesus continues and says, "I am come that they might have life and that they might have it more abundantly." The abundant life is not just spiritual. It is holistic. God's protection extends to your resources. God's protection extends to your financial health. I decree every satanic agent assigned to drain your finances exposed and expelled. Every covenant of financial failure broken. Every devourer released against your income rebuked. As Malachi chapter 3 verse 11 declares, "I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes." God personally rebukes the devourer. That is not your job alone. God takes it personally. I receive the rebuke of the devourer over my finances. I receive supernatural provision. I receive Philippians chapter 4 verse 19. "My God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." All your need, not some, not the spiritual ones only, all according to his riches, not your salary, not your circumstances, his riches. There is a man, I see him clearly, his name is Taiwo or Emmanuel or something similar. He has been under severe financial pressure for months. He has been borrowing to meet basic needs. He has been ashamed. He has been praying, but the answer has not come as quickly as expected. The Lord says, "I know the shame you have been carrying. I know the nights you lay awake calculating, but this is the last season of that kind of pressure. Something is about to break open for you financially. An unexpected source, an uncommon provision, something you did not calculate and cannot explain. Receive it. This is your season of turnaround. Now, let me address time restoration. Father, there are people who have lost time to the enemy. Seasons that were supposed to be productive spent in crisis. Years that were supposed to be building consumed by warfare. Opportunities that were supposed to land redirected by witchcraft. But Joel chapter 2 verse 25 is their promise. I will [music] restore to you the years that the locust have eaten. Restoration is in the nature of God. He sees what was stolen. He tracks the thief, and he commits to a full and supernatural restoration. I decree the acceleration begins today. What should have taken 10 years, God will do in one. What should have taken a season, God will accomplish in a moment. The lost time is being reclaimed. The stolen virtue is being restored. The wasted seasons are being redeemed. This is the day of double return for every single thing the enemy took. >> [music] >> There is a young woman. I see her, her name is Grace or Favor or something glorious like that. She gave 3 years of her life to a relationship that ended in betrayal. And since then, she has been carrying a wound she has not shown anyone. She has been smiling, but broken on the inside. She has been asking God what was the point. The Lord says to her tonight, "I did not waste those years. I was building something in you through every one of them. The wound is not your defining mark. The healing is and the right one, the one I ordained is already been aligned. Not as a consolation, as the original plan. Receive your restoration. Shala ah Yod El Roi Rofeka Jireh Mishkayan Adonai El Elyon Kala ah Shonda ah Father, we seal every prayer prayed tonight with the blood. Let the blood of Jesus speak over every word released from this altar. Let every decree find its target. Let every declaration be enforced by angelic hands. Let every prayer that was prayed tonight land in the spirit realm as fire and let the answers come. Let them come quickly. Let them come overwhelmingly. Let them come in a manner that removes every shadow of doubt about who is behind them. The siege is over. You have been under pressure. You have been under attack. You have been walking through a season that felt longer than it should have. But from this altar tonight, the siege lifts. [music] The pressure breaks. The season turns. Walk into your favor. It has been standing at the entrance of your day waiting for you to step into it.
